lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of 4 to 6 high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a repetitive longitudinal sequence posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of high-intensity blobs, forming a geometric grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with light-reflecting dorsal surfaces and shadowed ventral edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; a localized high-luminance mark resembling an abrasion is visible on the distal leading edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from fine-grained, high-density speckling on the dorsal cranial region to larger, discrete, grid-aligned blobs posterior to the fifth gill slit.
